title: Editor E3: Site renders off the registry with a surface filter and zero visual diff
detail: Site is a kind in the type system (LIVE-1171) but the published Space website still renders through its own path. It needs the web renderer mounted for kind site behind a surface filter (the filter lives only in git history today) and a zero-visual-diff proof against the Site baseline, which needs the first Spotlight and Site pictures (LIVE-1170). Start from lib/spaces/website.ts and the Site route. 2026-10-20: the house Home now resolves rows as kind site (LIVE-1173). Remaining here: a Site-only surface filter, and the zero-visual-diff proof, which needs a Site picture taken on the site host (see LIVE-1170).

verify.note: Passes once library code resolves rows for kind site.
